# HighDimensionalChaos

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Chaotic dynamics occurring in a high-dimensional state space, characterized by a large number of positive Lyapunov exponents and complex attractor geometry. Underpins the computational capacity of recurrent networks in both TCC and iNEST, as high-dimensional chaos enables rich, non-repeating signal processing and memory.
